{{Quote|This place is riddle with drilling rigs, they've ripped up the whole area!.''"<br />"''The Trade Federation doesn't care what it destroys as long as they get what they need.'|[[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and [[Jinkins]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Mount Merakan''' was executed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and [[Jinkins]] of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] in order to destabilizes the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] control of the [[Karthakk system]].

==Prelude==
After gaining new allies in the struggle against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for control of the [[Karthakk system]], the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] led by [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] set about attacking Federation installations on [[Maramere]].

==The mission==
Having split up with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Reti]], Nym and Jinkins continued on to [[Mount Merakan]] and discovered that the whole area had been transformed into a giant mining operation by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The Federation was using the ore to create [[trihexalon]]. Nym and Jinkins began destroying the operation and the escaping [[Trade Federation Freighter|freighters]] to ensure the deadly weapon would not reach its destination.

During the attack Nym was contacted by Reti informing him of the [[Attack on Point Modie]] and that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Cavik Toth]] and his [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]] were behind the recent attacks. After hearing that information, Nym and Jinkins evacuated the area as the mountain exploded due to battle damage.

==Aftermath==
With the destruction of the mining operation Nym and Master Gallia would regroup to attack [[Nod Kartha]], the primary producer of Hex weapons.

==Behind the scenes==
This article was created based on the mission "Mount Merakan" in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''. In the course of the mission it is possible to discover [[Easter egg]]s.
